title: He gives his coat to a beggar.
html_source: Perhaps a reference to the hagiographic stories of St. Martin of Tours who divided his cloak to keep a beggar warm in the winter.

anchor.text: He gives his coat to a beggar.
anchor.prefix: a raw turnip offered him by Maurice Butterly, farmer.) Fine! Splendid! (He refuses to accept three shillings offered him by Joseph Hynes, journalist.) My dear fellow, not at all! (
anchor.suffix:
) Please accept. (He takes part in a stomach race with elderly male and female cripples.) Come on, boys! Wriggle it, girls!
